storyCards.fact:
Hole's "Celebrity Skin" reached #85 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Celebrity Skin" is a song by American alternative rock band Hole, released on August 31, 1998, as the first single from their third studio album of the same name.

The song peaked at #85 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Celebrity Skin was released in 1998.
